description: Resolve an ENS name (vitalik.eth) to its Ethereum address, or a 0x address to its primary ENS name, with the avatar URL when one is set. ENS on Ethereum mainnet, resolved via ensideas.com; a name or address with no ENS record answers not found. Costs $0.001 per call.

query.description: An ENS name like "vitalik.eth" or a 0x address.

name: ens_lookup
title: ENS name lookup
